## RE:volution Mod v1.2.9

v1.2.9 introduces Rune Enhancement & Stat Framework. Rune enhancement is now a separate persistent fixed-slot system, the GUI provides distinct visual feedback for purchase/enhancement/awakening states, and awakening availability now reflects both progression and current affordability.

### Added
- Added persistent `+N` enhancement levels for all 26 fixed rune slots.
- Added enhancement amount selection: `x1`, `x5`, `x10`, `x100`.
- Each enhancement attempt independently rolls one of the 26 fixed slots; repeated hits are allowed.
- Empty fixed slots can store enhancement levels and apply them when the rune is acquired later.
- Added the v1.2.9 stat framework with linear enhancement scaling:
  - `finalPower = basePower × (1 + enhancementLevel × enhancementStep)`
  - current technical `enhancementStep = 0.1`
- Added enhancement state synchronization and regression coverage for enhancement metadata/stat behavior.
- Added final-value tooltip output for the currently supported rune effects.

### Changed
- Rune enhancement is fully separate from awakening/rank progression.
- Current technical enhancement cost is 10 Rune Dust per attempt; final economy balance is intentionally deferred.
- Purchase/duplicate feedback now uses a short clear blue/cyan slot pulse.
- Enhancement feedback uses a separate green slot pulse.
- Improved rank is shown by a soft light-silver persistent border.
- Advanced rank is shown by a soft light-gold persistent border.
- The old small top-left rank marker is no longer used as the primary rank indicator.
- The blinking awakening marker is now placed on the left side of the rune.
- Normal → Improved awakening availability uses a silver marker; Improved → Advanced uses a gold marker.
- The awakening marker now appears only when progression requirements are satisfied and the player can currently afford the configured awakening cost.
- Advanced runes no longer show a next-awakening marker.

### Fixed
- Prevented the awakening availability indicator from implying that an awakening can be performed when the required resource balance is insufficient.
- Cleaned up overlapping legacy rank feedback so achieved rank and next-action availability are visually distinct.

### Other
- Enhancement success is currently 100%; failure, breakage, and protection mechanics are not part of v1.2.9.
- Enhancement and rank multipliers remain independent parts of the framework.
- Full stat/status content expansion is deferred to v1.2.10 Rune Stats & Status Content.
- Runtime validation covered enhancement batches, persistent slot levels, purchase/enhancement pulses, achieved-rank borders, resource-aware awakening markers, and post-awakening indicator cleanup.
- Feature CI, develop CI, and main promotion CI completed successfully before release preparation.
- Updated all release version metadata to `1.2.9`.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.9.jar` on both client and server.

Compatible resource pack: [RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0), available in 64x64 and 128x128 variants.
